θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.

μαρμαίροντα: μαρμαίρω — flash, sparkle; pres. part. act., neut. acc. pl.: ’flashing’ · also pres. part. act., neut. nom. pl., agreeing with δώματα: ’gleaming’
μεμαώς: μέμονα (defective perf., pres. force) — be eager, be minded; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic μεμονώς): ’eager’
μετηύδα: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis · also + acc. in μετὰ νῶτα βαλών: ’behind, with the back turned’ · also + acc. of direction: ’to, back to’ (μετὰ νῆας ’to the ships’)
μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ), with an imperative: ’and do not’ · also with an optative of wish: ’and let … not’ (μηδ’ ἔτι … εἴην ’and may I no longer be’) · also with a hortatory subj.: ’and let us not’ (μηδ’ … ἀμβαλλώμεθα ’and let us not put off’) · also μηδ’ εἰ ’not even if’, before a condition with the indicative · also with an infinitive after a verb of bidding: ’and not to’ (μηδ’ ἐξέμεν ’and not to let go’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μοῖρα: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg. · also with an inf., ’it is fated’ (μοῖρα θανεῖν ’fated to die’)
μόθον: μόθος — press, the crush of battle; masc. acc. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’) · also μὴ μέν + fut. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … not’ (μὴ μὲν … ἐποχήσεται ’that no other man will ride’) · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also the negative of an infinitive in a reported threat: ’not to’ (μὴ πρίν … ἀπονέεσθαι ’not to go back until’) · also μή + pres. indic. after an oath, introducing its content: ’that … not’ (μὴ … πημαίνει ’that he does not harm’) · also the negative of an infinitive used as a command: ’and not to’ (μὴ δὲ … εἶναι ’and do not be’)
μῶλον: μῶλος — toil of battle, struggle; masc. acc. sg. (μῶλον Ἄρηος ’the toil of Ares’)
νέκυν: νέκυς — dead body, corpse; masc. acc. sg.
νέκυος: νέκυς — corpse, dead body; masc. gen. sg. (= Attic νεκροῦ), of separation with ἐκ: ’from the corpse’ · also masc. gen. sg., after πρόσθεν: ’in front of the corpse’ · also masc. gen. sg., of what is fought over, with ἀμφιμάχονται: ’over the corpse’
νέκυς: νέκυς — dead man, corpse; masc. nom. sg. · also masc. acc. pl., epic contracted νέκῡς (= νέκυας): ’the dead’
ναὶ: ναί — yes, verily; affirmative particle (ναὶ μὰ + acc. in oaths; ναὶ δή ’yes indeed’)
νεκροῦ: νεκρός — dead body, corpse; masc. gen. sg. · also masc. gen. sg. of separation after χωρέω: ’from the corpse’ (νεκροῦ χωρήσουσι ’will give way from the corpse’)
νεῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl. (= epic νηῶν)
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νυ: νυ — now, then; weak enclitic particle (= νῦν, Attic νυν)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῆάς: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’) · also masc. nom. pl. in the correlative οἳ μὲν … οἳ δέ: ’some … others’
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οἶδε: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 sg. with present force: ’knows’
οἷος: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. nom. sg., rough breathing (not οἶος ’alone’); in an indirect question: ’what sort of’ · also in a simile, introducing the likeness: ’like, just as’ (οἷος … ἀστήρ ’like a star’)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔλυμπον: Οὔλυμπος (Ὄλυμπος) — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg., goal of motion with the -δε ’to’ that follows
οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’whose, of which’ · ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’his own’ (οὗ πατρός ’his own father’)
πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl., elided (πάντ’ = πάντα)
πάρ: παρά — beside, with; prep. + dat., epic apocope πάρ (= παρά) · also πάρα (elided πάρ’) = πάρεισι: ’there are at hand’ · also πάρ = πάρα, for πάρεστι: ’is at hand’ (πάρ τοι ὁδός ’the way is at hand for you’)
πάτρης: πάτρη (Attic πάτρα) — fatherland, native land; gen. sg., Ionic η for Attic ᾱ
πάτροκλον: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. acc. sg.
πάτροκλόν: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. acc. sg., accent from the following enclitic θ’ (= τε)
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
πέρι: περί — about, over, for; prep. + gen. with anastrophe (accent thrown back, after its noun): ’over, about’ · also adv. of degree, with a genitive of the person: ’beyond others, exceedingly’ (οὗ πέρι … κραδίη ’whose heart beyond others’) · also prep. + acc. with anastrophe, after its relative pronoun: ’around’ (ἣν πέρι ’around which’) · also adv. of degree, with no genitive: ’exceedingly’ (πέρι … ἔρυτο ’guarded exceedingly’)
παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg., after ξύν · also masc. dat. sg., indirect object of δόμεν: ’to her child’ · also masc. dat. sg., after περί, of place or concern: ’around’ (φίλῳ περὶ παιδί ’around his dear son’)
παμφανόωντα: παμφαίνω — shine all over, gleam brightly; pres. part. neut. nom. pl., diectasis (= παμφαίνοντα): ’all-shining’ · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with δούρατ’: ’all-shining’ (δούρατ’ … ὀξέα παμφανόωντα ’sharp, all-shining spears’) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἐνώπια: ’gleaming’ (ἐνώπια παμφανόωντα ’the gleaming inner walls’)
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’) · also with αὐτόφι: παρ’ αὐτόφι ’right beside’ (the suffix -φι marks place) · also in παρ’ αὐτόθι, adverbial: ’right there, on the spot’
παράκοιτις: παράκοιτις — bedfellow, wife; fem. nom. sg., predicate
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην … πατρίδα γαῖαν ’dear native land’)
πατρόκλοιο: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πατρόκλῳ: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. dat. sg.
πατρός: πατήρ — father; masc. gen. sg.: ’(my) father’s’ (πατρός τε μέγα κλέος ’my father’s great glory’); also gen. of comparison after ἀμείνων: ’than his father’
πείσεις: πείθω — persuade, win over; fut. 2 sg.
πεποιθὼς: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα: trust, rely on (+ dat.); perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’trusting’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’)
πηλεΐδη: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. voc. sg., patronymic
πηλεΐωνι: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles (patronymic); masc. dat. sg.
ποδάρκης: ποδάρκης — swift-footed; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Achilles · also Ποδάρκης — Podarces, son of Iphiclus, leader of the men of Phylace; masc. nom. sg., proper name
ποδήνεμος: ποδήνεμος — wind-footed (πούς + ἄνεμος); fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.), epithet of Iris
πολέες: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl., epic πολέες (= Attic πολλοί)
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολέμῳ: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. dat. sg.
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ποτὶ γούνασι ’at the knees’) · also prep. + acc., ’against, up to’ (ποτὶ δ’ αὐτὸν τεῖχος ἔδειμαν ’built a wall against it’) · also adv., ’besides’, hardly to be translated (ποτὶ βρόμος ’the roar besides’)
πρίν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv.; and conj. + inf., ’before’; πρὶν … πρίν ’not … until’ · also πρίν … ὅτε, ’until the time when’ · also πρίν γε … ἠέ after a negative, ’until’
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πριαμίδην: Πριαμίδης — son of Priam; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προτετύχθαι: προτεύχω — make beforehand; perf. inf. pass., with ἐάσομεν + acc.: ’to have been done before, to be done and past’
πρώτοισιν: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
πρὸ: πρό — before, forth; adv. or preverb, in tmesis (πρὸ … ἧκε = προῆκε ’sent forth’); also prep. + gen. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, in defence of’ (πρὸ γυναικῶν ’for the wives’) · also prep. following its word, after a locative in -θι: ’before’ (Ἰλιόθι πρό ’before Ilios’) · also adv. in διὰ πρό, ’right through’ (διὰ πρὸ … ἐλάσσαι ’drive right through’)
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’) · also acc. pl. after ἐπί: ’on (both) feet’ (ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ’on both feet’) · also acc. pl. after ἐς: ’to the feet’ (ἐς πόδας ἄκρους ’to the tips of the feet’)
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός, σή, σόν — your; neut. acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά), agreeing with ἔργα: ’your’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
σάκος: σάκος — shield; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’the shield’ (σάκος … ἀνεδέξατο ’the shield received’)
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
στεῦτο: στεῦμαι — stand as if to do something; declare solemnly, vow, boast (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τάφρον: τάφρος — trench, ditch; fem. acc. sg.
τέτυκται: τεύχω — make, build, prepare; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made ready, has come to pass’ · also with a predicate noun: ’has been made, has become’ (ταμίης τέτυκται ’has been made steward’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’) · also indefinite τίς with a noun in a question after ἦ: ’some’ (ἦ τίς … θεός ’or some god’) · also indefinite τίς after μή, before the enclitic οἱ: ’lest anyone’ (μή τίς οἱ … κίοι ’lest anyone go off’) · also indefinite τίς after εἴ ποτε, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’if ever anyone’ (εἴ ποτέ τίς τοι) · also indefinite τις, written τίς before the enclitic φησι: ’someone’
ταῦτά: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’, accented before an enclitic · also elided ταῦτ’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεθνηῶτος: θνῄσκω — die; perf. part. act. masc. gen. sg., epic τεθνηώς (Attic τεθνεώς): ’dead’
τειρομένοις: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. dat. pl.: ’worn down’
τειρόμενοι: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’being worn down’
τελέσαι: τελέω — accomplish, bring to pass, fulfill; aor. inf.: ’to bring to pass’
τελαμωνιάδαο: Τελαμωνιάδης — son of Telamon, i.e. Ajax; masc. gen. sg., patronymic, epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα) · also neut. acc. pl., elided: ’armour’ (τεύχε’ ἀπούρας ’having taken the armour’)
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’armour’
τηλόθι: τηλόθι — far off, far away; epic adv. with suffix -θι, + gen.: ’far from’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’)
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’ (τοῖς ἄλλοις) · also masc. dat. pl., ’to them’ (τοῖς … μύθων ἦρχε ’led the talk before them’) · also masc. dat. pl. with a noun, demonstrative: ’these’ (τοῖς ἵπποισιν ’these horses’) · also relative, masc. dat. pl., + ἐπεποίθει: ’in whom’ (τοῖς ἐπεποίθει ’whom he trusted’)
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τρῳῇσι: Τρῳός — Trojan; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic Τρῳαῖς), agreeing with κυσί: ’Trojan (dogs)’
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)

τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)

(grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’
ἤρατο: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented (α lengthens to η): ’won’
ἤϊεν: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔει): ’was going’
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἥρης: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic Ἥρας)
ἥφαιστον: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; masc. acc. sg.
ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with πρό in tmesis: ’sent forth’) · also with ἐξ in tmesis: ’sent out’ (ἐξ … ἧκε = ἐξῆκε) · also with ἐν in tmesis: ’sent in, let loose among’ (ἐν … κυδοιμὸν ἧκε ’sent uproar among’)
ἰάχων: ἰάχω — cry out, shout; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic: ’crying out’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱσταμένη: ἵστημι — set, make stand; mid. stand, come to stand; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’coming to stand, standing’
ἴδηαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., epic -ηαι (= Attic ἴδῃ), after ἵνα: ’you may see’ · also aor. subj. mid. 2 sg. in a relative clause after ὅθι: ’wherever you see’ · also aor. subj. mid. 2 sg. in a condition after αἴ κεν: ’if you may see’
ἴδμεν: οἶδα — know; pres. 1 pl., epic ἴδμεν (= Attic ἴσμεν): ’we know’
ἴδωμαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with future force: ’shall I see’ · also aor. subj. 1 sg. mid. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that I may see’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴω: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 sg.: ’I go’, in a clause with ὁππότε … περ
ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (short ι by metre; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented, which the spelling cannot show)
ἶρι: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. voc. sg.
ἶρις: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. nom. sg.
ὀλίγη: ὀλίγος — little, small; fem. nom. sg.
ὀλύμπου: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, the mountain home of the gods; masc. gen. sg.
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
ὁμιλεῖ: ὁμιλέω — keep company with, consort, mingle; pres. 3 sg. act., + dat. or μετά + dat.: ’keeps company’
ὁππότε: ὁππότε — when; temporal conj., epic doubled π (= ὁπότε)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐπήρκεσε · also masc. acc. sg., object of βούλευσαν and of φύγοι: ’destruction’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of μαντεύεαι: ’destruction’
ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
ὄρσεο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, bestir oneself; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid. (ὄρσεο = ὄρσο): ’rise!’
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑποδείσαντες: ὑποδείδω — fear, be afraid before; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl., + acc.: ’fearing’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’)
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under; + gen. of agent: ’by, at the hands of’ · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἡμετέρῃσιν ’under our (hands)’) · also + gen. of cause: ’from’ (ὑφ’ ὁρμῆς ’from the onrush’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ποσσὶν ὑφ’ ἵππων ’beneath the horses’ feet’)
ὑψίζυγος: ὑψίζυγος — sitting on high (ὑψι- + ζυγόν, bench); adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
ὠκέα: ὠκύς — swift; fem. nom. sg., epic -έα (= -εῖα), epithet of Iris
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
